entities.title: Refresh the side-by-side page after changing a marked example
entities.summary: docs/side-by-side.md shows the marked tests verbatim, so it is regenerated whenever one changes.
entities.when: After adding or changing a test between # BEGIN <task-id> and # END <task-id> in this folder.
steps: From the repository root: python3 tools/side_by_side.py
Commit docs/side-by-side.md with the test change.
entities.verify: The check reports nothing out of date; CI runs the same check and fails otherwise.
